title: Starship Just Reached Orbit for the First Time
description:
On Sept 28, 2026, SpaceX's Starship reached orbit for the first time on its 14th test flight and released all 26 Starlink V3 satellites.
Each V3 is designed for about 1 Tbps of download capacity, roughly 10x the previous version, and is too big for Falcon 9.
